title: Valtoryn robot configuration
description: Declarative, schema-versioned robot variant configuration. Source of truth per docs/architecture/MODULARITY_SPECIFICATION.md section 3. Generated artifacts (URDF, launch, params) are build outputs and must be reproducible from this file plus module manifests.

schema_version.description: Config schema SemVer. Breaking changes increment major.

serial.description: Per-unit serial/UUID. Optional in simulation configs.

backend.description: Hardware abstraction execution backend: mock (software loopback), gazebo (physics sim via gz_ros2_control), or physical (real motor drives).

rmw.description: e.g. rmw_fastrtps_cpp, rmw_zenoh_cpp. Never mix RMWs in one system.

type.description: Reverse-domain module type name, e.g. com.valtoryn.chassis.differential.

version.description: SemVer range (REP-149 style), e.g. ^1.0, >=1.2 <2.0. Resolved against module manifest module_version.

parent_frame.description: REP-105 frame this module mounts to. Required for physical modules; omit for software-only.

occupied_mounts.description: Logical mount IDs claimed by this module. Each mount ID may be occupied at most once per robot (gate C2).

parameters.description: Module parameters consumed by the config generator and drivers. Values must carry traceable units documented in the module manifest.

safety_evidence.description: References to safety-evidence IDs (e.g. SE-000). References only — never safety claims.

unvalidated.description: Escape hatch for hardware outside the catalogue (R02 R7). Modules with unvalidated=true cannot pass gate C3 on motion/safety paths.
